rubrics.justification: Describes a generally good-quality day-5 blastocyst with plausible ICM/TE comments and notes the 3 vs expanded terminology issue, but relies heavily on the provided grade and includes uncertain image-based claims (e.g., cavity expansion, thinned zona) without precise visual support.
Strong integration of age, AMH/FSH, BMI, PCOS, prior ectopic, semen parameters, endometrial thickness, and smoking with embryo quality and prognosis.
Overall logical and well-structured, with conclusions mostly supported by the case data; minor issues include some speculative statements and slight overreach around future protocol choices.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice: SET favored at age 32 with a good blastocyst, caution that morphology does not equal ploidy, PGT-A optional, and ectopic follow-up emphasized. Minor deviations include speculative comments about freeze-all and trigger strategy without cycle hormone data.

Provides clear practical next steps: proceed with SET, smoking cessation, luteal support adherence, serial beta-hCG, early ultrasound for ectopic surveillance, and reasonable future-cycle review points.
